CustomField.description: Address Card Fields: the Address fields the Addresses card shows on every address beyond the ones it always shows, by API name separated by commas. Chosen from a checkbox list on the Addresses page of BarnCRM Settings; none ticked shows only the usual fields (R-AD10).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The extra Address fields shown on every address on the Addresses card.
CustomField.label: Address Card Fields
